conventions.units: Millimetres: 1 glTF unit = 1 mm. glTF assumes metres, so scale by unitScale (0.001) for AR or physically based lighting.
conventions.upAxis: Y, product base at y = 0, centred on x and z
conventions.compression: EXT_meshopt_compression with KHR_mesh_quantization; three.js needs GLTFLoader.setMeshoptDecoder
conventions.naming: Settled product names and codes per the SuDS Enviro brand system naming section; sales code first, drawing code carried alongside until the mapping is written
